description: Paste a .env file and get a safe .env.example with secret values stripped, comments kept.

faqs.a: Every KEY=value becomes KEY= (empty). Comments and blank lines are preserved; inline # comments stay attached.
Yes — `export KEY=value` lines keep their export prefix with an empty value.
Quoted values are emptied too, including multiline double-quoted values.
No — it runs entirely in your browser, so secrets never leave your machine.

howto: Click Generate — values are stripped, keys and comments remain.
Copy or download the result as .env.example.
title: .env.example Generator
